WITH budget_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    b.link_to_event,
    CASE 
      WHEN b.amount IS NULL OR b.amount = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (b.spent - b.amount) / CAST(b.amount AS FLOAT)
    END as ratio
  FROM budget b
),
event_avg_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM budget_ratios
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
events_with_location_and_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    e.event_id,
    COALESCE(e.location, 'No Location') as location,
    ear.avg_ratio
  FROM event e
  INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM budget) b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
  LEFT JOIN event_avg_ratios ear ON e.event_id = ear.link_to_event
),
ranked_events AS (
  SELECT 
    event_id,
    location,
    avg_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY location 
      ORDER BY 
        CASE WHEN avg_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
        avg_ratio DESC
    ) as rank
  FROM events_with_location_and_avg
)
SELECT 
  event_id,
  location,
  avg_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked_events
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY location, rank
